meta.name: Aussie Shore
meta.description:
Follow the wild antics of a group of young and rowdy housemates as they work hard, and party even harder whilst navigating the highs and lows of living together 24/7 in the non-stop party town of Cairns.

Not complete. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 not on server | S3 not on server

videos.title: Ready To Launch
videos.overview: It's the first day in the Aussie Shore house and 8 new Shories arrive for a summer of partying, outrageous antics, no holds barred hook ups and romantic messiness in the non-stop party town of Cairns.

videos.title: I’m Back Bitches
videos.overview: Day 2 in the Aussie Shore house and chaos erupts as new hotties Jaeda, Cooper, and Lexie arrive. A love triangle begins to brew, a family member departs, and the gang gets a rude awakening the next morning from a furious Geordie Shore legend.

videos.title: Banana Humping
videos.overview: The family grows closer, and the gang get to grips with heavy manual labour working at a banana farm. Lexie is left reeling when she sees Tom and Lily hooking up, Con and Catia continue to flirt, and Kyle makes it his mission to tune Manaaki.

videos.title: Something in the Air
videos.overview: Lily and Tom wake up together, claiming it's no-strings fun. Tom reveals he's free to pursue Lexie, sparking tension. After a wild night of hookups, the crew goes bungee jumping. Nardos spills a secret, causing the Lily-Tom-Lexie triangle to blow up.

videos.title: Truth or Dare
videos.overview: Charlotte sends the gang to work, where they get a huge surprise. Lily questions Tom's loyalty when she sees him flirting with Lexie again. Con and Catia hook up, but she's left devastated by his actions the next day.

videos.title: Goon Sack
videos.overview: After calling Lily the wrong name, Tom's caught between her and Lexie, causing tension on a camping trip. Hungover and irritated, Lily confronts Tom, thinking Lexie's catching feelings. Jelly wrestling ensues, and Tom decides to end the chaos.

videos.title: The Ick
videos.overview: Lily struggles to keep her emotions in check as Tom hooks up with Lexie. Con leaves Catia confused over their relationship. Manaaki and Kyle get into trouble at work and the gang take to the skies for a jaw dropping adventure.

videos.title: Bad Bitch Birthday Behaviour
videos.overview: It's Catia's birthday, and Con's pulling out all the stops. But things take a turn when a reality star arrives and tensions explode - could this be the end of Con and Catia? Lexie sets her sights on the new guy - is she about to repeat past mistakes?

videos.title: Boat Party From Hell
videos.overview: Lexie's crushing on Callum, but drama brews as he gives her the cold shoulder. Manaaki's pot stirring leaves everyone guessing if he fancies Callum too. After a messy night, the gang heads out to sea, a storm hits, whilst someone ends up in hospital.

videos.title: Out With a Bang
videos.overview: The gang head out on their last job and reunite with some familiar faces. Jaeda opens up to the group, which brings them all closer together and the housemates struggle to contain their emotions as their time in the house finally comes to an end.
